products.tagline: Breast Care for Women. Cost Effective Solution for Mammography.

highlights.title: Key Highlights
items: Compact Design with a built-in Generator
Full Color Monitor and Dual Control Button

highlights.title: Increased Efficiency and High Patient Throughput
items: Automatic Exposure Control system ensures consistent image quality with reliable intensity. This provides conventional automatic exposure control with object thickness and compensation during the exposure according to the tissue composition.
Highly Sensitive Fiber Grid Bucky Device
Highly sensitive fiber grid reduces scatters, which results in clear diagnostic images.
ELMA-T3 has comfortable compression. When the operator requires some level of pressure, MICOM control soft-touch system minimizes the discomfort of exam within the pressure range.

features.label: Advanced Features
features.title: Designed with Comfort and Efficiency for Women’s Breast Care
text: Dual control buttons are placed on both sides for vertical travel and rotation of the c-arm. Thanks to isometric motorized rotation of c-arm, breast positioning can be done comfortably and quickly. Auto-positioning function allows operator to easily adjust preset positions by touch buttons.
The digital display of the compression force that is put on the breast when taking an X-ray aids in avoiding patient discomfort due to compression force.

features.label: Excellent Operation with Generator Built in Slim Body
features.title: Compact Size : Built-in Generator
features.text: Thanks to its built-in generator, neither external generator cabinet, nor extra cabling is required. Thus, it makes installation very easy and saves space.

features.label: Excellent Operation with Generator Built in Slim Body
features.title: High Frequency Inverter System
features.text: With maximum tube current 100mA @ 25kV, a high-resolution image can be acquired in a short period of time, which will enable a detailed diagnosis.

features.title: Full Color Touch LCD Control Panel
features.text: Using full color touch LCD control panel, a user can easily manage various data, including control setting information.

items.title: Dual Control Buttons On both Sides
Highly Sensitive Fiber Grid Bucky Device
